capabilities: Generate a table of contents from headings via an insta-toc code block
Update the ToC automatically in real time as headings change
Omit headings with an <!-- omit --> comment or local settings
Handle HTML, special symbols, markdown links, and wiki-links in headings
Configure bullet style, update delay, indentation width, and exclusions
extras: The README warns that local settings use YAML and are sensitive to spacing (only 2-space indentation works, or errors occur), with auto-correction planned. Installation via Obsidian, BRAT, npm, or manual download is documented.
motivation: The author built it to mitigate limitations of other ToC plugins, such as generation via command activation and restrictions on heading hierarchy.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in automatically maintained table of contents, and other ToC plugins only regenerate on command and restrict heading structure.
summary: Table of contents generator that maintains a live-updating ToC in a note via an insta-toc code block.
